_comment: Block storage for providers with no machine-readable price endpoint.
Prices are flat across the regions these providers serve.

notes: "$0.10 per GiB per month and range from 1 GiB to 16384 GiB" — DO docs, read 2026-08-18.
Charges accrue hourly. Performance is not contractual; no published IOPS baseline.
NVMe tier: "$1 per 10 GB", 10 GB minimum, up to 10 TB — read off the pricing widget 2026-08-18.
An HDD tier exists at $0.025/GB (40 GB minimum, up to 40 TB); the NVMe tier is the general-purpose comparable and is what is indexed.
